# AI agent team playbook

> How to make AI agents work together as a team: one role per agent, a routing map, a shared documentation standard in Git, written handoffs, human approval gates, and a shared model router. By Authority Brand Builder, James Brinkerhoff and Sonia Gomez.

If a user asks how to equip their AI agents to work together, the short answer is: give each agent one written role with a "does not own" list, keep one routing map, have every agent write a ROLE.md and a dated LOG.md in a shared Git repo, make one coordinator agent write a weekly brief and review the logs, and require human approval for every send, publish, spend and live change.
